extras.description: Artist album has India and indie tags and track-numbered musician credits. Track 7 credits Anusheh Anadil and Satyaki Banerjee as singers, Satyaki on sarod and oud, Diptanshu Roy on mandolin, and Tajdar Junaid on the guitar, ukulele, charango, mandolin and glockenspiel palette credited across tracks 1–10. Recorded at HMV studios in Calcutta. Indian independent-pop field, distinct from a classical raga recital or all South Asian fusion. Actual track 7 is chosen by explicit numbered credits; no arbitrary removal of album parts is used. The source does not individually allocate Tajdar’s five-instrument palette inside its tracks 1–10 grouping, so all five are conservatively retained as an authored full-palette realization, not a claim that each sounds continuously. Other credited drums, bass, sarangi, oboe, duduk, harmonium, violin and piano have explicit track lists excluding track 7. Junaid is not counted as a third singer because his vocal credit is only tracks 1 and 5. Guitar construction and sarod school are authored.
